_meta.description: Optional MCPs (NOT loaded by default). Run `/setup-mcp` to activate any of these. Activation patches `opencode.json` and restarts opencode to take effect.
_meta.rationale: 100% value when needed, 0% cost (no boot slowdown, no leaked tokens) when not. The active MCPs (context7, playwright) stay loaded for everyone; these opt-ins are user-triggered.

optional_mcps.name: github
optional_mcps.description: Read GitHub issues, PRs, code search, repo metadata directly from the agent. Replaces manual `gh` CLI invocations with structured MCP tools (list_issues, get_pull_request, search_code, etc).

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub PAT. Needs 'repo' scope for full read, plus 'read:org' if working with org repos. Generate at https://github.com/settings/tokens (fine-grained token recommended).

optional_mcps.use_when: Reviewing PRs that need GitHub context, fetching issues, code search across the org, automating release notes from merged PRs.

optional_mcps.name: postgres
optional_mcps.description: Read-only SQL queries against a PostgreSQL database. Useful for debugging production issues, validating schema, running ad-hoc analytics. By default the connection is read-only (separate role recommended).

POSTGRES_CONNECTION_STRING.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Format: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname?sslmode=require. RECOMMEND a read-only role for safety.

optional_mcps.use_when: Investigating data issues, validating migrations, debugging ORM queries against real data, writing postmortems with concrete numbers.
